objective: Select and develop a bounded-resource estimator/history path by proposed-load voltage prediction, joint uncertainty and execution cost; keep SOC/Q stable while focusing RC/EOD utility.

application_targets.Q_target_status: user accepted approximate practical target, not proof of observability or hard exclusion
application_targets.rule: Report existing0.5%Qmetrics alongside the new1%working target for continuity. Weak/unresolved Q remains explicit. Hardware voltage/risk requirements must be supplied before an operational pass/fail claim.

first_study.repetition_rule: Restore the complete same starting state before every repeat; alternate arm timing order and exclude truth generation, plotting and IO. No repeated observations added to an already-updated history.
forecast_anchor_phases: one16-record block immediately before the next scheduled full refresh
immediately after that same refresh attempt
halfway through the following cadence interval
first_study.phase_rule: Match source boundaries and observation prefixes across arms. Record accepted/rejected refresh status; do not force success.
first_study.temperature_rule: Hold measured checkpoint/anchor temperature constant over each controlled fork; label forecast conditional on that declared schedule. Later temperature-change tasks separate.
first_study.current_rule: Positive current is discharge. Same absolute public current commands for both cells; never derive commands from hidden Q. Label poorly excited or out-of-training loads as extrapolation even inside physical domain.
first_study.timing_rule: Initial witness50Hz; all listed durations are integral samples. For other rates report any duration rounding and preserve actual1/Fs intervals; evaluate instantaneous load edges separately.
first_study.stop_rule: Domain/support failures remain unresolved. Do not clamp SOC/hysteresis, discard problematic points, or silently renormalize away unsupported uncertainty.

inputs: source identity and committed record boundary
read-only estimate/history handle with original prior and joint state/parameter uncertainty
declared current or power task and temperature assumption
optional battery-terminal cutoff and path requirements
outputs: minimum voltage and occurrence time, including initial edge
joint local uncertainty/support status and numerical evaluation error
prohibitions: No truth, future observed voltage or true parameters supplied to forecast.
No reusing a forecast as new observation evidence.
No independently varying RC parameters while discarding their covariance.
No raw endpoint Gaussian treated as a certificate for the nonlinear original-coordinate history.
forecast_contract.power_load: Start with prescribed current. Constant-power/regulated tasks require voltage-dependent I=P/(eta*V), a declared efficiency/power-path model and explicit low-voltage failure; do not substitute fixed current.
forecast_contract.minima: Include0+ and every command transition, search intra-segment extrema and check numerical refinement; sampling only50Hzendpoints may miss minimum voltage.

stages.name: Bind replay and export complete state
work: Restore original checkpoints under original source/binary/runtime binding. Never weaken replay checks.
A new experiment wrapper may read/call the preserved environment; record wrapper identity and derived exports separately.
Export source/count/interval/config identities, full joint readout and all tangent/field state required to reproduce continuation. Isolate plant truth in a scoring-only object.
If importing into instrumented/new implementation, validate same-stream numerical continuation before benchmarking; do not relabel it as original replay.
deliverables: derived state schema and ownership rules
stages.gate: All source/chronology checks pass; snapshots leave original banks unchanged. Import and readout do not add evidence.

stages.name: Matched resource ledger
work: Replay16384newobservations from each of12prefixes for field64/tangent64 only.
Separate validation/adapter, response recurrence, lifted-field QR, tangent-or-rolling update, full refresh, mean transport and covariance/application readout.
Measure uninstrumented complete advance separately from instrumented phase costs; report instrumentation overhead.
Measure persistent data, active workspace, stack and simultaneous peak occupancy by lifetime; report Python heap and C/target estimates separately.
Count double arithmetic, division, transcendental calls, square roots, matrix/QR dimensions and maximum solver iterations; identify workload-dependent work.
Measure mean/median/p95/p99/max and refresh bursts; report host/compiler/thread setup. Use compiler/RTL measurements for target cycles if available.
stages.gate: No whole-system memory or M23 timing claim from partial payloads or host timings; include all refresh work and distinguish bounded work from average cost.

stages.name: Causal proposed-load prediction and error attribution
work: Freeze estimates before each workload; no future voltage assimilation or fit. Preserve inherited z/v1/v2/v3/h, reference parameters and full joint dependence.
Compare published full endpoint messages from both arms; additionally evaluate tangent original-coordinate nonlinear transport as a separately labeled geometry ablation.
Forecast noiseless battery terminal voltage at event boundaries including0+, through the task and recovery. Score against an independent scalar plant fork only after predictions are frozen.
Propagate full joint local covariance; add deterministic joint-direction nonlinear/support probes, labeled diagnostics rather than probability bounds.
Inspect voltage-margin threshold sweeps without asserting a hardware cutoff or calibrated admission risk.

Separate point forecast, state error, RC-response error, hysteresis/OCV/capacity contribution and uncertainty. Truth substitutions permitted only as post-prediction scoring ablations, never candidate inputs.
If near-EOD states are absent, declare a separate causal discharge continuation using public controls and measured-voltage stopping. Never set estimated SOC or RC states from truth.
stages.gate: Uncertainty remains provisional until independent calibration; evaluate path minima jointly, not pointwise3SD bounds treated as trajectory guarantees.

stages.name: Profile-selected tangent improvements
work: Select the largest demonstrated cost with clear semantics; change one candidate at a time.
First candidates: reduce crossings/allocations, reuse explicit buffers, fuse response/update operations, and remove duplicated recurrence without retaining unbounded lifted rows.
Evaluate mean/domain validation every commit separately from application-requested covariance readout; all samples still update history and failures remain visible.
Cache only values keyed to unchanged prior/config/source, anchor, factor or transport generation; include invalidation tests across temperature, interval and refresh changes.
If shared field storage dominates, open a separate history-factor representation study. Preserve cross terms and chronological state;32bitstorage alone cannot fit the current82Dfactor in10KiB.
Route shared prediction bias to partition/transport/sensor diagnostics before changing estimator behavior; do not improve plots by smoothing reported parameters.
stages.gate: Preserve owned evidence, joint uncertainty, domain checks and useful predictions. Report small roundoff changes with severity; do not tune tolerances after results or add arbitrary forgetting/inflation.

stages.name: Freeze and qualify selected candidate
work: Retest replay/checkpoints, original controls, weak/rest/reversal cases and interval handling at35Hz and50Hz.
Use fresh independent noise seeds and independent embedded load seeds; retain paired inputs for candidate/control. Include both cells, weak/wide traversal and low-SOC episodes.
Run short coverage/prediction pilot before new72h/720h campaigns. Treat trajectories, not correlated samples, as independent uncertainty units.
Promote only on recorded prediction stability, decision utility, failures, resources and explicit limitations; keep default promotion distinct from merging an optional backend.
After stationary qualification, schedule separately designed aging and model-mismatch studies;72hstationary evidence does not establish ten-year behavior.
stages.gate: No deployment claim without calibrated application risk, hardware power-path assumptions and measured target memory/deadlines.

target.core: baseline Cortex-M23 custom silicon / Verilog simulation
target.schedule_rule: Average window cycle budget is not a sample-latency guarantee; account for buffering and full-refresh scheduling. No dropped/reordered samples.
target.memory_rule: This is a lower bound for retaining this dense triangular numeric layout, not an information-theoretic lower bound. Include all contexts/prior/live state/tables/workspace/output/buffers in target peak ledger.

repair_routing.finding: both arms have same consequential voltage bias
only field64 admission changes with refresh phase
repair_routing.action: carry tangent forward; preserve evidence-based stability benefit

repair_routing.finding: RC parameters differ but predicted voltage is acceptable
repair_routing.action: avoid spending resources forcing each nuisance parameter to its truth

repair_routing.finding: uncertainty misses or unsupported geometry change admission
repair_routing.action: repair or explicitly bound the identified approximation; retain unresolved status

repair_routing.finding: performance dominated by common history factor
repair_routing.action: prioritize shared factor compaction, not micro-optimizing only the tangent context

open_requirements: Battery-side voltage cutoff, allowable transient duration and hardware power path.
Representative current/power tasks, regulator efficiency and acceptable admission risk.
Target compiler/ABI and access to cycle/stack measurements in the Verilog environment.
Independent validation budget after candidate freeze; existing witnesses cannot certify rare brownout risk.
invariants: Original public prior once; chronological ownership and actual intervals unchanged.
Full cross terms retained; no arbitrary exponential forgetting, variance inflation or parameter smoothing.
No new long campaign needed for the first resource/forecast scorecard.
All old artifacts and replay sources preserved.
